title: Strict ordinary Tate quotient pre-tower data
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T, a prime ell invertible on T, and d natural, there exist a pre-tower P with tower, level, evaluation, normalization, and transition fields of an AdicTower, isomorphisms from P.level n to the single complex in degree -2d of quotientLine T ell n d, and P.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d. The cocycle field is omitted.

source.place: Steps 2–3: quotient-linear pre-tower before cocycle coherence

proof.text: Construct the strict quotient tower with quotient-linear levels by ordinary tensor balancing on the locally free integral root tensor. Exact single-complex evaluation gives the displayed level comparisons; the strict quotient tower supplies the tower, evaluation, normalization, and transition fields.

mathlib_searches.query: existence of quotient-linear derived tower data without the cocycle field

lean.statement:
theorem strictTateTensorTower_pre
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ (P : StrictTateTensorTowerPre T (datum.{u} ell))
      (q : ∀ n : ℕ, P.level n ≅
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).obj
          (quotientLine T ell n d)),
      P.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d
